Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Glass Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the glass damage reported on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

This loss is covered under your comprehensive coverage. Specifically, your policy states: "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations." Additionally, the policy notes that "Repair of a windshield chip without replacement is paid with no deductible."

As a result of this approval, the payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued to you. Please note that no {DEDUCTIBLE} applies to this specific claim.

Next steps: Payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us directly.

Sincerely,

ClaimPilot Claims Team
